packageRules.description: A new Kubernetes minor version needs work in k8s/patch.go, so it gets a pull request of its own.
The k8s module (tabernetes-overlay) only compiles inside the Kubernetes checkout.
The pod kernel is linux-source-6.8.0, which only Ubuntu 24.04 ships. A new Ubuntu release means a new kernel and a new test of vm/kernel.config, so it is not updated here.
